operator_confirmation_package_purpose: Define the minimum operator confirmation collection package required before any future binding implementation authorization task can be considered. This package captures explicit human confirmation that the operator accepts the proposed driver binding and acknowledges the consequences, including the ability to request a rollback afterward.
required_operator_confirmation_fields: explicit_human_operator_confirmation_of_identity_capture (boolean, identity capture count and scope confirmed)
explicit_human_operator_confirmation_of_mutation_acknowledgment (boolean, operator acknowledges driver binding will mutate Windows registry)
explicit_human_operator_confirmation_of_no_mutation_safe_state_before_binding (boolean, operator acknowledges safe state captured before any binding action)
explicit_human_operator_confirmation_of_manual_audit_awareness (boolean, operator acknowledges full audit trail requirement)
operator_confirmation_timestamp_utc (string, ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of confirmation)
operator_confirmation_source (string, source of confirmation — e.g., chatpad_ui, manual, authorized_script)
operator_confirmation_chain_integrity_hash (string, SHA-256 hash of canonical_lf_text concatenation of all fields above)
operator_confirmation_status (string, one of: CONFIRMED, REJECTED, NO_OP, PENDING_VERIFICATION, INSUFFICIENT_DATA, MANUALLY_REVOKED)
operator_confirmation_rejection_no_op_ru: MANUALLY_REVOKED → authorization_task_terminated, all prior authorizations invalidated
rollback_no_op_package_purpose: Define the minimum operator confirmation collection package required before any future binding implementation authorization task can be considered. This package captures explicit human confirmation that the operator accepts the proposed driver binding and acknowledges the consequences, including the ability to request a rollback afterward. No rollback action is performed by this design gate — it only defines the contract.
required_rollback_no_op_package_fields: rollback_package_version (string, version of rollback package schema)
rollback_package_target_instance_id (string, InstanceId of target for rollback)
rollback_package_source_driver_name (string, source driver name from prior driver provider identity)
rollback_package_source_driver_version (string, source driver version from prior driver provider identity)
rollback_package_safe_state_evidence_path (string, path to safe state evidence captured before binding)
rollback_package_container_id (string, shared ContainerId for rollback scope)
rollback_package_timestamp_utc (string, ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of rollback package)
rollback_package_issuer (string, human operator identifier for rollback)
rollback_package_source (string, source of rollback package — e.g., chatpad_ui, manual, authorized_script)
rollback_package_chain_integrity_hash (string, SHA-256 hash of canonical_lf_text concatenation of all rollback fields)
rollback_package_status (string, one of: CONFIRMED, REJECTED, NO_OP, PENDING_VERIFICATION, INSUFFICIENT_DATA, MANUALLY_REVOKED)
